parsed.degree_signal: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
parsed.notes:
The qualifications section defaults to required; “ist wünschenswert” and “sind von Vorteil” make their respective bullets optional.
Read “Shell Scripting (Bash), T-SQL oder Python” as alternatives; Bash and Python share group 1, while T-SQL remains unmapped.
Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL are kept unmapped because the taxonomy has no matching specific entries; generic SQL is not separately requested.
The occupational titles under “Wen wir suchen” describe vacancies, not candidate skill requirements; no skills are inferred from those titles.
AI infrastructure appears only in the role description and is excluded.
The unspecified Studium maps to bachelor; vocational training and a comparable qualification are explicitly accepted alternatives.
No stated level, qualifying experience duration, proven-experience wording, or leadership duty establishes seniority.
